collection.title: Audi A4 Avant 2001 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi A4 Avant 2001 to 2003 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Side Latch arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The choice of rear screen wipers for this A4 Avant which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
